analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 39.7 maintains a neutral zone, a slight increase from 36.6 five days ago but no confirmation of exiting oversold territory. MACD histogram at -2.9452 continues to worsen, maintaining a bearish trend after a death cross. ADX at 27.1 indicates a clear trend formation, but -DI (40.7) is dominant over +DI (13.3), suggesting downward pressure. Weekly RSI at 43.8 is in a bearish zone, trading below the weekly SMA20 by -4.98%. 52-week position at 57.5% is neutral. Five-day return volatility shows a pattern of expansion followed by convergence: -0.27% → -0.48% → +4.58% → -3.52% → -1.97%. Current price $720.01 is below SMA200 at $733.86 by -1.89% and below EMA50 at $753.04 by -4.39%. Trading within the swing support of $682.88 and resistance of $753.02. Overall, no clear buy/sell bias in indicators, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
